perItemFindings.one_line: Delivered tier incremental < floor field; not salvageable within scope.

verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=incremental below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The note proves sharpness for its finite latent-type model, but most headline machinery—compression, Charnes–Cooper endpoints, dual sign certificates, nesting, and projection—is generic finite-program geometry applied to a newly specified response array. The case-margin “frontier” is only the instruction to compute both fibers and compare their endpoint codes, rather than an interpretable characterization of when case frequencies can replace exposure margins. The only worked example has ratio exactly one for every sensitivity value, so it does not demonstrate informative waning bounds, an interior breakdown point, substitution failure, or feasible confidence-set computation. Because the unrestricted default delta=1 and the exact transported exposure margins are scientifically demanding, the absence of a substantive computation leaves practitioner usefulness unestablished and keeps the contribution below field level. The framing is formally consistent with the proved statements, but its emphasis on an exact frontier and usable projection exceeds what the delivered generic tests and degenerate example establish as an applied contribution. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6 < 7.2, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]

HALTED AT TRIAGE: the math panel returned `revise` and its findings were never repaired, so this note is NOT established as mathematically sound — do not bank it as downgraded on this verdict alone. Open findings: related_work_omission@thm:perenyi-collapse-boundary, ballast@prop:k2-worked-compatible-lift
